stem: Which situation represents a proportional relationship?

options.label: F
options.text: The cost of purchasing a basket of oranges for $1.30 per pound plus $5.00 for the basket

options.label: G
options.text: The cost of purchasing peaches for $7.00 per box of peaches with a delivery charge of $3.00

options.label: H
